verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents generic task assignment with deadlines for working with the team and auditor (sprinto-docs-5/24) and alerts tied to evidence collection (sprinto-docs-3). Its AI evidence gap analysis checks uploaded evidence for timeliness and flags outdated timestamps (sprinto-docs-28/47), which only gets close to expiry handling. The owner, due-date and ownership tracking in sprinto-docs-44 covers AI-system findings rather than manual evidence artifacts in general. missing for 10: explicit per-artifact owners and due dates for manual evidence, recurring renewal reminders, expiry/validity-period tracking on manual uploads, independent or hands-on corroboration.
